newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian shares end mostly lower on profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Belgian shares end mostly lower on profit-taking.

text.p: 1440 GMT - Brussels Bel-20 leading share index .BFX ends 15.21 points, or 0.61 pct, lower at 2,472.86 points as profit taking hits market following recent record run.
* Bright spots among Bel-20 stocks few and far between with Barco, Generale Bank and UCB only blue chips to post gains.
* Construction, dredging firm CFE ends up 3.57 pct at 11,600 francs, off highs reached on brokerage upgrades.
* Processed meat company Ter Beke down 2.73 pct at 3,200 francs as outbreak of swine fever in Belgium sparks fears about rising pork prices hitting firm's margins.
